title: Hangover-cure Mediterranean Shio-cure Tacos
description: A pungent, light, and invigorating Mediterranean dish to alleviate hangover symptoms, featuring shio-cure and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients wrapped in tortillas.
instructions: Rehydrate the shio-cure by soaking it in 1 cup of ayurvedic herbal tea at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
In a medium bowl, mix together chopped parsley, chopped dill, sliced red onion, and crushed fresh garlic.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a small pan over medium heat. Add the onion and herb mixture and sauté for 5 minutes.
Add the rehydrated shio-cure to the pan and stir to combine with the onion and herb mixture.
Add a squeeze of fresh lemon juice and stir to combine.
Warm the tortillas and fill each with a portion of the shio-cure mixture.
Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sprinkle with coarse black pepper to serve.
Serve with a side of ayurvedic herbal tea for added invigoration and hangover relief.
